audience: Editors and workspace members managing CMS entries

context.toolbar: Labels for the CMS content toolbar. Preserve concise action labels because this surface is dense and responsive.
context.card: Content list and grid card copy, including action button labels, aria labels, owner/date fallback text, and draft status.
context.state: Loading, error, empty, and retry copy for content lists. Keep failures actionable without exposing backend internals.

formatting.itemCount: ICU plural message. Preserve the {count} variable and plural structure.
formatting.titleVariables: aria labels that include {title} must preserve that variable exactly.
formatting.ownerVariables: avatar alt text must preserve {owner} exactly.

security.secretPolicy: Do not mention JWTs, API keys, hashes, or internal diagnostics in user-facing content states.
security.htmlPolicy: Messages are rendered as text. Do not add HTML markup to catalog values.
